verdict.rationale: Azure supports multi-resource automation in two ways: scripting the Azure CLI and REST APIs (with JMESPath `--query` to select resource sets), and declarative IaC (Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform) that deploys many resources from one definition. However, no evidence shows a native bulk-operation feature for acting on many existing items at once; users must script loops or rely on declarative deployment. Missing for 10: explicit documented bulk/batch operations (e.g., batch update or delete across resources), evidence of bulk actions on existing items rather than provisioning, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
